description: This file implements the QuicChromiumAlarmFactory class and the QuicChromeAlarm class, which are used to create and manage alarms within the QUIC protocol implementation in Chromium. It includes definitions for setting, canceling, and firing alarms, integrating with Chromium's task and timer systems.

classes.name: QuicChromeAlarm
classes.description: A custom alarm class that integrates Chromium's timer system with QUIC's alarm interface, allowing alarms to be scheduled and triggered within Chromium's task environment.

methods.name: QuicChromeAlarm
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the alarm with the provided clock, task runner, and delegate.

methods.name: SetImpl
methods.description: Sets the alarm to fire at the specified deadline, scheduling the Chromium timer accordingly.

methods.name: CancelImpl
methods.description: Cancels the alarm, stopping the Chromium timer.

methods.name: OnAlarm
methods.description: Callback invoked when the Chromium timer fires; checks if the alarm should fire or be retried.

methods.name: NowTicks
methods.description: Returns the current time in ticks, based on the Chromium clock.
